dataset.name: P0 — Global Status
dataset.description: Four groups: identity + current flow, the walking dots, the since-reset pair, then network and LED.

dataset.name: P1 — Instant Flow
dataset.description: Two columns of four. One self-describing element per sensor; the unit is in the header, as on every telemetry page.

dataset.name: P2 — Cumulative Volume
dataset.description: Two columns of four on P1's grid, in m3. Absorbs the old litres page: 1 L = 0.001 m3, so one page carries both readings.

dataset.name: P3 — Session Volume
dataset.description: Session volume in m3. Absorbs the old session-litres page for the same reason.

dataset.name: P4 — Max Flow Since Reset
dataset.description: Per-channel peaks since the last session reset, with MAX marking a channel that hit its q_max ceiling — i.e. a sensor under-dimensioned for its pipe.

dataset.name: P5 — Enter Configuration
dataset.description: A prompt, not a menu. The body says what Configuration contains; the footer says the gesture. Neither repeats the other.

dataset.name: Nyquist Validation Warning
dataset.description: Shown when f_theoretical exceeds Nyquist limit. UP=Edit, DOWN=Save anyway.

dataset.name: Idle (display off)
dataset.description: Backlight off state. Any button press returns to Info mode.

dataset.name: CFG.M — Modbus
dataset.description: Config root entry CFG.M. ENTER descends into the Modbus level: slave address, baud rate, parity and stop bits.

dataset.name: CFG.D — Display
dataset.description: Config root entry CFG.D. ENTER descends into the Display level: the LED pulse settings and the unit the panel shows flows in.

dataset.name: CFG.S — Sensors
dataset.description: Config root entry C7. ENTER opens the sensor selector, where UP/DOWN pages through the eight channels and ENTER opens the settings of the one shown.

dataset.name: C.BACK — Back
dataset.description: Ascends one level, out of Configuration. — laid out to the §7 back template.

dataset.name: M1 — Modbus ID
dataset.description: TEMPLATE for every setting page. Title names the setting, so the value needs no label; the range gives context before editing.

dataset.name: M1.V — Edit Modbus ID
dataset.description: TEMPLATE for every value editor. New above Saved, aligned on one column so the change is directly comparable.

dataset.name: M2 — Baud Rate

dataset.name: M2.V — Edit Baud Rate
